Only one photo because my camera is not great. I priced it by what a similar one went for at a local auction house. No returns.

evidence.summary: CITES listing for African or Asian elephant ivory: Asian elephant: Appendix I.

data.cites: Asian elephant: Appendix I. African elephant: Appendix I, except the populations of Botswana, Namibia, South Africa and Zimbabwe, which are in Appendix II with an annotation that restricts trade in their ivory.

evidence.summary: Interstate sale of African elephant ivory is prohibited except ESA antiques (at least 100 years old, not repaired with ivory since Dec 27, 1973, imported through an antique port where applicable) and de minimis items (ivory under 200 grams, not more than 50% of the item by volume or value, made before July 6, 2016, with import-date conditions) (applies because the item ships from US-FL).

data.rule: Interstate sale of African elephant ivory is prohibited except ESA antiques (at least 100 years old, not repaired with ivory since Dec 27, 1973, imported through an antique port where applicable) and de minimis items (ivory under 200 grams, not more than 50% of the item by volume or value, made before July 6, 2016, with import-date conditions). Intrastate sale is allowed federally only with proof of lawful import before Jan 18, 1990; states may be stricter.
